verdict.rationale: NVIDIA describes Isaac Lab as an open-source framework, and Isaac Sim has a public GitHub repository (isaac-sim/IsaacSim). A community source independently reports that Isaac GR00T N1 was released under the Apache 2 license. Together these show a user can read the source of the major Isaac components under open terms. Missing for 10: an explicit license statement for the Isaac Sim repository and for Isaac ROS, a named license for Isaac Lab, and confirmation that the full Sim runtime (not just parts) is open.
